title: Quick Start Guide - Clone & Customize in 5 Minutes
excerpt: Welcome! This guide will help you clone this portfolio and personalize it for your own use in just a few minutes.
content:
Welcome! This guide will help you clone this portfolio and personalize it for your own use in just a few minutes. [[SECTION_ID:prerequisites]] ## Prerequisites Before you start, make sure you have: - **Git** installed ([Download Git](https://git-scm.com/)) - **Python 3.x** installed ([Download Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/)) - A **GitHub account** (optional, but recommended for forking) - A **text editor** (VS Code, Sublime Text, or any editor you prefer) [[SECTION_ID:step-1-clone-the-repository]] ## Step 1: Clone the Repository Open your terminal and run: ```bash git clone https://github.com/bayzed123/sayadbayezid-portfolio-.git cd sayadbayezid-portfolio- ``` This creates a local copy of the entire portfolio on your computer. [[SECTION_ID:step-2-run-the-setup-script]] ## Step 2: Run the Setup Script The setup script will automatically personalize all files with your information. [[SECTION_ID:on-macoslinux]] ### On macOS/Linux: ```bash bash setup.sh ``` [[SECTION_ID:on-windows-using-git-bash-or-wsl]] ### On Windows (using Git Bash or WSL): ```bash bash setup.sh ``` [[SECTION_ID:what-the-script-does]] ### What the script does: - Prompts you for your name, website, GitHub, LinkedIn, and other details - Automatically updates all HTML files with your information - Updates the LICENSE file with your name - Updates the Python conversion script with your name [[SECTION_ID:example-prompts]] ### Example prompts: ``` Enter your full name: John Doe Enter your website URL: www.johndoe.com Enter your GitHub username: johndoe Enter your LinkedIn profile URL: linkedin.com/in/johndoe Enter your email address: john@example.com Enter your blog URL: johndoe.blogspot.com ``` [[SECTION_ID:step-3-install-dependencies]] ## Step 3: Install Dependencies The blog system requires Python dependencies. Install them: ```bash pip install beautifulsoup4 markdown ``` [[SECTION_ID:step-4-test-the-blog-system]] ## Step 4: Test the Blog System Create a test blog post to ensure everything works: 1. Create a file named `test-post.md` in the `blog_uploads/` directory: ```markdown # My First Blog Post This is my first blog post using the automated blog system. [[SECTION_ID:section-1]] ## Section 1 Content for section 1 goes here. [[SECTION_ID:section-2]] ## Section 2 Content for section 2 goes here. ``` 2. Run the conversion script: ```bash python scripts/convert_blogs.py ``` 3. Check the `blogs/` directory - you should see a new JSON file for your post. [[SECTION_ID:step-5-deploy-your-portfolio]] ## Step 5: Deploy Your Portfolio Now you're ready to deploy! Here are some popular options: [[SECTION_ID:option-a-github-pages-free]] ### Option A: GitHub Pages (Free) 1. Push your repository to GitHub 2. Go to Settings → Pages 3. Select `main` branch as the source 4. Your portfolio will be live at `https://yourusername.github.io/sayadbayezid-portfolio-` [[SECTION_ID:option-b-netlify-free]] ### Option B: Netlify (Free) 1. Go to [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com/) 2. Click "New site from Git" 3. Connect your GitHub repository 4. Netlify will automatically deploy your site [[SECTION_ID:option-c-custom-domain-paid]] ### Option C: Custom Domain (Paid) 1. Purchase a domain from a registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, etc.) 2. Deploy to your hosting provider 3. Update DNS records to point to your hosting [[SECTION_ID:file-locations--what-to-customize]] ## File Locations & What to Customize Here's where to find and customize key elements: | Element | File | Line(s) | What to Change | |---------|------|---------|----------------| | Main Portfolio Page | `index.html` | ~1-50 | Title, meta tags, hero section | | Portfolio Content | `index.html` | ~100-1000 | About, projects, services sections | | Blog Listing Page | `blog.html` | ~1-50 | Blog page title and styling | | Blog Post Template | `blog-loader.html` | ~1-100 | Blog post styling and layout | | Footer Credit | `index.html` | ~1102-1107 | Keep your name here (required) | | License | `LICENSE` | ~1-50 | Your name and terms | | Python Script | `scripts/convert_blogs.py` | ~108 | Author name in generated JSON | [[SECTION_ID:adding-your-own-content]] ## Adding Your Own Content [[SECTION_ID:1-update-the-main-portfolio-indexhtml]] ### 1. Update the Main Portfolio (index.html) Open `index.html` and customize: - **Hero Section**: Change the main headline and description - **About Section**: Write your bio - **Projects Section**: Add your projects - **Services Section**: List your services - **Contact Section**: Add your contact information [[SECTION_ID:2-add-blog-posts]] ### 2. Add Blog Posts Create blog posts in either format: **Markdown (.md):** ```markdown # Your Blog Title Your introduction paragraph here. [[SECTION_ID:main-section]] ## Main Section Content for main section. [[SECTION_ID:sub-section]] ### Sub-section More detailed content. Check out this video: https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/videos/1778234182274-27bf1cc3-fc30-483b-b4ec-0ed606effe74.mov ``` **HTML:** ```html

Your Blog Title

Table of Contents

  • Section 1

Section 1

Your content here

Watch this video: https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/videos/1778234182274-27bf1cc3-fc30-483b-b4ec-0ed606effe74.mov

``` **Video Embedding:** Simply paste the direct URL of your video (e.g., `https://example.com/your-video.mov`) anywhere in your blog content. The system will automatically detect and render it as an interactive video player. Save to `blog_uploads/` and run `python scripts/convert_blogs.py`. [[SECTION_ID:3-update-social-links]] ### 3. Update Social Links Find and update these in `index.html`: - GitHub: `github.com/yourusername` - LinkedIn: `linkedin.com/in/yourprofile` - Blog: `yourblog.blogspot.com` - Email: `your.email@example.com` [[SECTION_ID:project-structure]] ## Project Structure ``` sayadbayezid-portfolio-/ ├── index.html # Main portfolio page ├── blog.html # Blog listing page ├── blog-loader.html # Individual blog post template ├── setup.sh # Personalization script ├── README.md # Project overview ├── WIKI.md # Technical documentation ├── QUICK_START.md # This file ├── LICENSE # Open source license ├── blog_uploads/ # Upload blog posts here (.html or .md) ├── blogs/ # Generated JSON blog files │ ├── index.json # Index of all blog posts │ └── {blog-slug}.json # Individual blog post JSON ├── scripts/ │ └── convert_blogs.py # Blog conversion script ├── .github/ │ └── workflows/ │ └── blog_automation.yml # GitHub Actions workflow └── assets/ # Images, CSS, and other assets ``` [[SECTION_ID:troubleshooting]] ## Troubleshooting [[SECTION_ID:blog-posts-not-appearing]] ### Blog posts not appearing? 1. Ensure files are in `blog_uploads/` directory 2. Run `python scripts/convert_blogs.py` 3. Check that JSON files were created in `blogs/` 4. Verify `blogs/index.json` was updated [[SECTION_ID:links-not-clickable-in-blog-posts]] ### Links not clickable in blog posts? 1. Ensure URLs are properly formatted (e.g., `https://example.com`) 2. For HTML, use proper `` tags 3. For Markdown, use `[Link Text](URL)` syntax [[SECTION_ID:setup-script-not-working]] ### Setup script not working? 1. Ensure you're in the repository directory: `cd sayadbayezid-portfolio-` 2. Make script executable: `chmod +x setup.sh` 3. Run with bash: `bash setup.sh` [[SECTION_ID:next-steps]] ## Next Steps 1. ✅ Clone the repository 2. ✅ Run the setup script 3. ✅ Customize your content 4. ✅ Add your blog posts 5. ✅ Deploy to your hosting 6. ✅ Share your portfolio! [[SECTION_ID:need-help]] ## Need Help? - Read the full [WIKI.md](WIKI.md) for technical details - Check the [README.md](README.md) for project overview - Review the [LICENSE](LICENSE) for usage terms [[SECTION_ID:attribution]] ## Attribution This portfolio is open source and free to use. If you use this code, please keep the footer credit: **"Portfolio & Blog System by [Your Name](https://yourwebsite.com)"** This helps others discover this amazing portfolio template! --- **Happy coding! ** For questions or improvements, feel free to open an issue or contribute to the project.
